"""Count case-insensitive ASCII word tokens."""
import re

_WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]+")


def word_counts(text):
    """Return a dict mapping lowercase ASCII words ([a-z]+) to their counts.

    Matching is done on ASCII letters before lowercasing, so non-ASCII
    characters (including ones whose lowercase form contains ASCII letters,
    such as KELVIN SIGN or LATIN CAPITAL I WITH DOT) act as separators, as do
    apostrophes, digits, punctuation and whitespace.
    """
    counts = {}
    for token in _WORD.findall(text):
        word = token.lower()
        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
    return counts
